note: How a kith is raised steers how it grows. Each source pulls on attributes in ATTRS order (might, grit, finesse, nerve, wits, heart, presence). Pulls build up as habits; at every level up a share of growth follows the habits. The player never spends points: they choose what the kith eats, where it sleeps, what work it does, who tends it and how it fights.

feed:grain-mash.name: Grain mash
feed:grain-mash.hint: cheap and heavy; builds bulk, slows the feet

feed:marrow-broth.name: Marrow broth
feed:marrow-broth.hint: for hard bones and long marches

feed:bitterleaf.name: Bitterleaf
feed:bitterleaf.hint: sharpens the mind, sours the temper

feed:honeycake.name: Honeycake
feed:honeycake.hint: a treat; soft, glossy and loyal

feed:lean-rations.name: Lean rations
feed:lean-rations.hint: what an army can spare; wiry and wary

feed:glowmoss.name: Glowmoss
feed:glowmoss.hint: rare; they carry themselves differently after

work:herd.name: Leading the herd
work:herd.hint: the others start to follow it

work:tend.name: Tending the sick
work:tend.hint: lying beside the hurt in the infirmary

work:rest.name: Resting
work:rest.hint: no pull either way; habits fade

pen:high-loft.name: High loft
pen:high-loft.hint: wind and drop on every side

pen:forge-yard.name: Beside the forge
pen:forge-yard.hint: noise, sparks and heat every day

pen:quiet-field.name: Quiet field
pen:quiet-field.hint: grass, sky and time to think

battle:cover.name: Covering its partner
battle:cover.hint: every hit it takes for someone

battle:call.name: Answering the Call
battle:call.hint: the big moment, with everyone watching

lull:wild.name: A wild lull
lull:wild.hint: calm on the outside; the light goes out of its eyes

handler.note: Whoever tends a kith rubs off on it: their two highest attributes pull at this strength, and their heart raises bond.

might: is filling out through the shoulders
has gone thin through the shoulders
grit: has a thicker hide and heavier bones
wits: seems dull and slow to notice
heart: has turned cold and hard to reach
presence: carries its head high; the others give way
keeps to the back of the pen
